messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
On which electronic platform is the procedure (RDO) for awarding the IGEA lifting devices periodic verification service carried out?

response.text: Su quale piattaforma elettronica viene svolta la procedura (RDO) per l'affidamento del servizio di verifica periodica dei dispositivi di sollevamento IGEA?
